crossRefs.note: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
translations.bsb: As for the sons of Merari, you are to number them by their clans and families,
translations.kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
translations.asv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them by their families, by their fathers' houses;
